sql.organizations:
SELECT id, dept AS department, domain, website
                  FROM org
                  WHERE domain IS NOT NULL OR website IS NOT NULL
sql.claims:
SELECT id::text AS id, source, org_hint AS "domainHint", status
           FROM quarantine_raw
           WHERE kind = 'claim' AND org_hint IS NOT NULL
sql.baseline:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM org)::int AS organizations,
                    (SELECT count(*) FROM source)::int AS sources,
                    (SELECT count(*) FROM event)::int AS events
